text: This clip shows how the owner orders materials from a vendor.
The owner starts a new purchase order and picks the vendor, Keystone Sign Supply. Then they add the materials: wrap film and overlaminate, three hundred feet of each, at the vendor's price.
The owner downloads the order as a PDF. They send it to the vendor from their own email.
A few days later the rolls arrive. The owner opens the order and marks the whole order received at once.
Back on the materials list, what you pay updates to this order's prices. No shelf counts to keep up.
